Beware Bokoblins carrying this weapon.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 12 |durability = 20 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Dragonbone Boko Spear}} Dragonbone Boko Spears are [[Weapon]]s used by [[Black Bokoblin]]s, [[Silver Bokoblin]]s, and [[Golden Bokoblin]]s, as well as [[Black Moblin]]s, [[Silver Moblin]]s, and [[Golden Moblin]]s. They are most commonly found near the [[Necluda Sea]] and on [[Hyrule Ridge]]. Dragonbone Boko Spears belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by [[Bokoblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} They are [[Boko Spear]]s that have been enhanced with fossilized bones, positioned so the fangs will bite opponents. Being made of wood, Dragonbone Boko Spears will float if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. If exposed to [[Fire]] or equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]], they will start to burn. Also, unlike metal Weapons, they do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]].
